briefing.headline: There is no move worth your only free transfer at £0.1m in the bank, so bank it, tidy the bench and armband, and decide next week whether to fund Bruno Fernandes — the one player the top 10k almost all own and 94% of them captain.

do.why: With £0.1m in the bank every affordable swap is either marginal or a sideways downgrade. Holding gives you 2 FTs for GW5, which is the only way to reach B.Fernandes (£12.0m) without a hit: Haaland (£15.5m) + Semenyo (£8.4m) out, Bruno + Thiago (£7.9m) in is 53.5 xP over five gameweeks becoming 55.9, and leaves £4.1m to fix the bench.

do.action: Move the vice-captaincy from Cherki to Haaland.
do.why: Cherki's xP next is 4.26; Haaland's is 5.57. If your captain plays 0 minutes you want the better fallback, and it costs nothing.

do.action: Reorder the bench: van Ewijk first, then Maguire, Kusi-Asare last.
do.why: Kusi-Asare sits third at 0.41 xP with 49 career minutes and no place in Fulham's predicted XI, ahead of van Ewijk at 4.02 xP and Maguire at 3.22. As it stands an auto-sub could bring on a player who will not appear.

consider.action: Semenyo → Tavernier (£8.4m to £6.0m) with the free transfer.
consider.why: For: +1.54 xP this week (5.51 v 3.97), +3.3 over five (25.3 v 22.0), and it banks £2.4m towards fixing the Kusi-Asare bench slot. Against: Tavernier is owned by 2.9% overall and 1.3% of the top 10k, so you are backing a model read on a £6.0m midfielder with fixtures BRE(H)3, LIV(H)4, CHE(A)4; and spending the FT now leaves you one transfer in GW5, which kills the two-move Bruno route entirely. Do it only if you have decided you are keeping Haaland.

consider.action: Plan the GW5 double move to B.Fernandes, funded by selling Haaland.
consider.why: For: 98% of the top 10k own Bruno and 94% captain him — every week he hauls you lose double to the people you are chasing, and his xP is level with Haaland's (31.7 v 31.5 over five). Against: Haaland is owned by 71.2% of the whole game, which is the field that actually decides your 3.3m rank, and selling him means being off both templates if he goes on a run. It is a rank trade, not a points trade; the numbers are a wash.

For: wildcard, free hit and bench boost must all be played by the GW19 deadline, so there is a real risk of a wasted chip if you keep drifting. Against: nothing this week triggers one — no blank, no double, and only one broken squad slot (Kusi-Asare). A wildcard to buy one player you can reach with two normal transfers is a waste.

ignore.action: Starting van Ewijk over Semenyo or Tarkowski.
ignore.why: van Ewijk's 4.02 xP beats Semenyo's 3.97 and Tarkowski's 3.86 by less than a tenth of a point — inside the noise — and over five gameweeks Tarkowski (19.8) is clearly ahead of van Ewijk (16.8). Leave the XI as it is.
Your bench totals 10.26 xP but £4.5m of it is Kusi-Asare at 0.41. A chip that must last until GW19 should not be spent on a fourteen-and-a-half-man squad in a single gameweek.

660 career minutes, only 180 this season, 0.7% owned and 0% of the top 10k. That number is an extrapolation from two and a bit starts, and at £5.5m you cannot afford him anyway with £0.1m in the bank.

captain.why: João Pedro has the highest xP in your squad at 5.88, at home to Hull (FDR 2), against Haaland's 5.57 away at Manchester City's opponents (FDR 4) — inside 0.5, so it is close. The bigger point: 94% of the top 10k captain B.Fernandes and you do not own him, so your armband is a differential whatever you do. Given that, take the higher expected score rather than the safer name. João Pedro is owned by 98.3% of the top 10k but captained by only 0.7%, Haaland by 3.3%.

briefing.chips: No chip this week. Triple captain is gone (GW3); wildcard, free hit and bench boost are all still live but none has a trigger — no blanks or doubles in GW4 and only one dead squad slot. Keep them, but note all three expire at the GW19 deadline, so pencil the bench boost in for the first proper double and treat the wildcard as your response to a real cluster of problems, not to a single missing midfielder.
risks: The predicted lineups were fetched on 7 September for a 12 September deadline — no press conferences have happened. Rotowire's XIs and any injury or international-break knock could change Verbruggen, Cherki or João Pedro's status before you lock in.

The GW5 Bruno plan assumes you sell Haaland and Semenyo at today's prices. Selling price is purchase price plus half the rise, and the model assumes current price; if either has risen since you bought, the £12.0m for Bruno may not quite be there.
João Pedro's captaincy edge over Haaland is 0.31 xP — well inside the model's error. A Hull side that sits deep flips it.
van Ewijk (270 minutes, all this season) and Kinsky (270 this season) are thin-evidence players propping up your bench value; if either loses their place the squad is thinner than it looks.
The model carries no penalty-taker bonus, so Szoboszlai and Haaland's spot-kick duty is not in their xP — a mild reason their numbers understate them.
